lines.1: --Except our homeroom teacher hadn't shown up.
lines.3: 「Homeroom can't end until the teacher gets here.」
lines.4: 「She's taking forever. Probably chatting away in the faculty room again. This is what I can't stand about real women.」
lines.5: 「That comment proves your life is already over, Fukahire.」
lines.7: 「I-I understand how you feel, but nooo.」
lines.9: 「I keep telling you, don't call me Yoppi!」
lines.10: Our class representative, Yoshimi Sato--better known as Yoppi--was taking everyone's complaints at once.
lines.11: She's always flustered and saddled with extra trouble, but somehow the role suits her.
lines.12: 「We're getting nowhere. President, hand down a ruling.」
lines.13: 「I hereby rule that we go home.」
lines.14: 「--Is what I'd dearly love to say.」
lines.15: 「N-no, we can't. We can't just end homeroom without the teacher.」
lines.17: The Princess gave us a wry smile.
lines.18: Even the Princess has a soft spot for Sato--or at least can't say no to her.
lines.20: Subaru collapsed onto his desk again.
lines.21: 「Fine. You there... Um, I forgot your name. Potato Face.」
lines.24: 「We're in the same class. You could at least remember his name...」
lines.27: 「Go to the faculty room and bring Inori back.」
lines.31: 「(That's the Princess... Ordering people around like it's the most natural thing in the world.)」
lines.34: Everyone seemed to have something on their mind.
lines.37: 「Everyone, please forgive me. I'm afraid I'm late.」
